contract_notes: Water is represented only as separate diversion and consumptive-use fields.
Ag economics use only Census of Agriculture operations/producers and BEA farm proprietor income (D4).
DOR productive-value fields are coefficients and link to the fiscal ledger; assessed values are not duplicated.

rangeland_acres.notes: AG LAND excl cropland/pastureland/woodland. Excludes pastureland (see pastureland_acres).

land_in_farms_acres.notes: FARM OPERATIONS - ACRES OPERATED (2022 COA); sum of cropland+pastureland+woodland+other_ag.

other_land_acres.derivation: county_area_acres - land_in_farms_acres; never absorbs reconciliation error.

reconciliation_error_acres.notes: (cropland + pastureland + woodland + other_ag) - land_in_farms. Must be 0 or near 0.

beef_cows_head.notes: Census 2022 COA value retained; NASS QuickStats 2022 survey value suppressed (D).

forage_acres.notes: Derived: pastureland(excl cropland+woodland) + other_ag_land(excl cropland+pasture+woodland). Proxy only.

stocking_rate_aum_per_acre.notes: State-average estimate: 30 ac/AUM = 0.0333 AUM/ac (NRCS WY Grazing Lands Technical Note range: 20-40 ac/AUM).

aum_capacity.notes: forage_acres × 0.0333 AUM/acre. Confidence low: actual stocking rate varies significantly by range condition and federal allotment.

federal_aum_share.notes: Needs USFS active AUMs, which no source here provides. BLM-only share is aum_by_ownership.blm_share_of_forage_capacity.

usfs_authorized_use_acres.notes: USFS EDW S_USA.Allotment.zip; area-weighted intersection split (59 polygon pieces). 5 invalid geometries repaired via buffer(0).

JC-1.call: RAS 'Permitted AUMs' is read as BLM active AUMs.
JC-1.evidence: Suspended exceeds Permitted in 167 rows, so Permitted cannot include suspended; WY sums 1,923,355 permitted / 393,770 suspended against BLM-published 1,920,781 / 393,635.

JC-2.call: AUMs apportioned to counties by polygon area share (EPSG:5070).
JC-2.evidence: BLM public acres by county from this apportionment are within 5% of independent BLM SMA surface acres in 20 of 23 counties (outliers: Goshen 0.89, Teton 0.09, Johnson 0.947); AUM density within an allotment is assumed uniform.

JC-3.call: Public-land proportion (RAS public acres / polygon acres, capped at 1) scales acres, not AUMs. RAS AUMs are already public-land AUMs, so county AUMs = AUMs x area share; multiplying by the proportion again would discount private and state inholdings twice and cut the statewide total to about 67% of BLM's published figure (1,285,306 vs 1,920,781).
